summary: If pods fail to load plug-ins after a chart upgrade, the bundle and chart versions don't align. Compare the plug-in file names in the plugin-registry pod (oc exec ... ls -l /opt/app-root/src | grep ansible-plugin) with helm list, then download the right bundle, update the registry and let pods restart.
